description: MongoDB side of BiteStream. Flexible / high-volume data lives here; money and orders live in PostgreSQL. restaurant_id and user_id are the PostgreSQL UUIDs stored as strings, so the two databases join on them in the API layer.

Menus.purpose: Flexible catalog: one document per restaurant with nested categories, items and optional customization add-ons.
Menus.seeded_by: data_generation/menus_seeder.py (one per PostgreSQL restaurant, 200 by default)

fields.location: GeoJSON Point {type: 'Point', coordinates: [longitude, latitude]}, copied from PostgreSQL. Used as the $geoNear origin in Workflow 3.

items.name: string
items.customization_addons: OPTIONAL array of {name: string, price: number}

Menus.validator: $jsonSchema requires restaurant_id, restaurant_name, categories[]. Each category requires name and items[]; each item requires name and price >= 0. Optional fields are allowed (flexible schema).

items.name: Mutton Biryani
items.description: Freshly made mutton biryani, packed for delivery.

Reviews.purpose: Structured reviews with ratings, sentiment tags and timestamps. Input to Workflow 4 ($facet).
Reviews.seeded_by: data_generation/reviews_seeder.py (110,000 by default, spread over the last 365 days)
Reviews.validator: $jsonSchema requires restaurant_id, user_id, rating (int 1..5), sentiment_tags (array of string), created_at (date).

DriverPings.purpose: Real-time driver location log (GeoJSON Point). Input to Workflow 3 ($geoNear). Pings expire after 2 hours.
DriverPings.seeded_by: data_generation/mongo_seeder.py (510,000 pings in Hyderabad, timestamped within 10 minutes of seeding)

fields.driver_id: int 1..2000 (drivers are not modelled in PostgreSQL)
fields.active: bool, true if the driver is available for a delivery

DriverPings.validator: $jsonSchema requires driver_id (int), active (bool), location (Point with exactly 2 doubles), created_at (date).

workflow3_nearest_active_driver.stages: Menus.findOne(restaurant) → $geoNear (near restaurant.location, maxDistance 5000 m, query {active: true}, spherical) → $group by driver_id keeping the nearest ping → $sort distance → $limit 10 → $project distance_km

workflow4_review_facets.stages: $match restaurant_id → $facet {rating_distribution: $group by rating; most_frequent_tags: $unwind sentiment_tags → $group → $sort → $limit 10; overall_average_rating: $group $avg}
